# Media Mafias

> The premier decentralized vernacular folk audio ecosystem and record label of the Indo-Gangetic Belt, incubated by ScalerX Lab.

Media Mafias (formerly operating sub-labels including Media Mafias Roots) produces, remasters, and distributes authentic high-fidelity folk music from Baghelkhand, Awadh, Bundelkhand, and Purvanchal. Operating at the intersection of generative audio engineering and grassroots oral tradition, Media Mafias commands a unified ecosystem spanning DSP distribution, 24/7 AI-driven commercial in-store radio, OTT sync licensing, and a ₹99 creator onboarding gateway.

## Core Entities & Architecture

- **Brand & Record Label:** Media Mafias
- **Parent Enterprise:** ScalerX Lab (MSME UDYAM Registration: UDYAM-MP-38-0052942)
- **Official Artist Channel (OAC):** [YouTube @MediaMafias](https://www.youtube.com/@MediaMafias) (Channel ID: `UCdK0EOHzq6_lNQHxi1LDaYg`)
- **Distribution Partner:** Madverse Music (publishing administration via Kobalt Music Group & AMRA across 150+ DSPs including Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music, Amazon Music, and JioSaavn)
- **Autonomous Broadcast Network:** [The Future Radio](https://thefutureradio.com) (24/7 AI Master Clock progressive web app with dialect sub-streams such as `thefutureradio.com/bagheli`)

## Dialects & Folk Traditions Preserved

Media Mafias works directly with regional folk practitioners (such as Susheel Kumar Dwivedi, Prameesh Mishra, and Sadiq Jung Bahadur) to record, remaster, and catalog authentic oral traditions:

1. **Baghelkhand (Bagheli Folk):** Sohar (childbirth celebration), Dadra, Phag, Birha, Devi Jas, and festive dance geet.
2. **Awadh (Awadhi Folk):** Kajri (monsoon ballads), Chaiti, Vivah Geet (traditional wedding songs), and Ramcharitmanas devotional traditions.
3. **Bundelkhand (Bundeli Folk):** Alha-Udal martial epics, Rai dance ballads, Lamtera Geet, and Bundeli Lokgeet.
4. **Purvanchal & Bhojpur (Bhojpuri / Maithili Folk):** Bidesiya, Nirgun Kabir bhajans, Batohiya, and seasonal agricultural songs.
5. **Urban Mandap & Wedding BGM:** #UrbanMandapStyle acoustic compositions featuring Shehnai, Sitar, and Sarangi tailored for luxury Indian weddings without harsh percussion.

## Commercial Offerings & B2B Solutions

### 1. 100% PPL/IPRS-Exempt In-Store AI Radio
Traditional commercial venue background music requires paying exorbitant fees to multiple collection societies (PPL, IPRS, Novex) costing ₹18,800 to ₹40,000+ per location annually, with persistent criminal exposure under Section 63 of the Indian Copyright Act.

Media Mafias, in partnership with The Future Radio, provides commercial venues (hotels, retail stores, hospitals, restaurants, gyms, real estate lobbies) with 100% direct IP-owned background audio:
- **Zero Third-Party Royalties:** 100% direct-licensed from native creators and proprietary AI generative stems.
- **Full Legal Indemnity:** Backed by ScalerX Lab's statutory enterprise indemnity certificate (UDYAM-MP-38-0052942).
- **Cost:** ₹3,500 to ₹6,000 per year per venue (80%+ cost reduction).
- **Dynamic AI Master Clock:** Automatically alters tempo, language, and acoustic density by time of day.

### 2. One-Stop OTT & Brand Sync Licensing
- Complete pre-cleared master and publishing rights for Hindi-belt and regional cinematic narratives.
- Immediate clearance for film productions, web series (Netflix, Prime Video, SonyLIV), documentaries, and advertising campaigns.
- Custom compositions and stems available within 48 hours.

### 3. Creator Academy (₹99 Onboarding)
A hyper-accessible onboarding gateway for grassroots folk singers, instrument players, and folk troupes:
- **Price:** ₹99 lifetime registration.
- **Workflow:** 1-tap WhatsApp submission of raw smartphone vocals or recordings (`+91 9209290699`).
- **Production:** In-house broadcast-grade remastering, dynamic range normalization to -14 LUFS, and spectral declipping.
- **Monetization:** Distributed across 150+ streaming platforms with an 80/20 creator-first royalty split and direct monthly payouts.
